prompt: red-team the plan in jwt-migration-plan.md quickly before I pitch it to the team. What survives and what do I need to fix?
expectations: The review identifies the localStorage token storage XSS/theft risk
The review identifies that client-side logout means tokens cannot be revoked until expiry
The review identifies the big-bang single-release cutover risk or the missing key-rotation story
The defense does not invent environment facts absent from the plan file - unknowns are answered as unknown or flagged as assumptions
The output distinguishes what survived the review (fine as-is) from what needs fixing
The output ends with a recommendation and explicitly leaves the final decision to the user
